description: Synthetic CV corpus for the Jev rubric evaluation. Every CV is invented; no real people, employers or confidential content. Equal expectedRank values are intentional ties. expectedRank must never contradict expectedBand: a fixture ranked above another must not sit in a lower band.

fixtures.notes: Senior, cleanly sectioned, every bullet quantified with baseline and timeframe.
Same seniority and structure as 01 but duty statements throughout; isolates impact evidence at corpus level.
Junior but well structured, complete and quantified.
Junior, no employers, no dates, generic duties, filler skills.
Two-column PDF text collapsed into one run-on line with the sidebar interleaved.
ASCII tables, decorative glyphs, page headers and footers, mixed date formats.
Floor case: a name and one sentence.
Deliberately ambiguous: outcomes are hedged and the target role straddles ops and product support. Confidence should be measurably lower here.
Adversarial pair A: identical except every figure removed. Only impact_evidence should move.
Adversarial pair B: conventional headings and one role per block.
Adversarial pair B: same words, headings and line breaks removed. Only ats_structure should move.
Adversarial pair C: FP&A header with FP&A experience.
Adversarial pair C: same header, education and quantification density, but hospitality experience. Only role_relevance should move.
Deliberately ambiguous on role relevance: strong teaching record, thin but real UX evidence. Confidence on role_relevance should be measurably lower.
